sql: SELECT avail_season, avail_doy, value FROM climate WHERE index_id='oni' AND avail_season IN (5,6) ORDER BY avail_season, avail_doy

SELECT fished_date_season AS season, cls,
  CASE WHEN fished_date_doy<121 THEN '1_spring' WHEN fished_date_doy<213 THEN '2_summer' WHEN fished_date_doy<274 THEN '3_early_fall' ELSE '4_late_fall' END AS period,
  SUM(yt)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0) AS yt_per_angler,
  SUM(anglers) AS anglers, COUNT(*) AS n_trips
FROM trips
WHERE cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight','three_quarter')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY season, period, cls
